label: UKMTO: Critical
description: Strait of Hormuz remains effectively closed — open transits near zero since 6 May 2026. Iran seized stateless tanker JIN LI (ex-OCEAN KOI, IMO 9255933) in the Gulf of Oman on 8 May citing oil-export disruption; US naval units repelled multiple threats transiting the Strait on 5 May; bulk carrier attacked by small craft 11NM W of Sirik on 3 May. Mine threat in the TSS, sporadic GNSS interference and aggressive IRGC hailing continue; 41+ incidents logged by UKMTO since late February across Arabian Gulf, Strait of Hormuz and Gulf of Oman. Red Sea / Gulf of Aden elevated — Houthis signalled resumption of attacks on Western-linked shipping in response to US-Israeli strikes on Iran; most carriers maintain Cape of Good Hope routing. Gulf of Aden / Somali Basin piracy threat sustained following the late-April / early-May hijacking cluster.
